propagation: Eulerian constant velocity: backward flow last->penultimate scaled by horizon, approximate fixed-grid extrapolation

regions: nonoverlapping32x32,8horizons; reject risk higher is worse
threshold: leave-one-original-video-out: 90th percentile risk among nonharm regions in OTHER videos; heldout false rejection and harmful recall reported, no test data
limits: pooled region AUROC descriptive, correlated observations; threshold calibration not confidence guarantee; no future visibility GT
